objects.query: SELECT BasedOnId, CanRamp, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, DisplayUrl, Family, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, QuantityUnitOfMeasure, SpecificationType, StockKeepingUnit, Type, UnitOfMeasureId FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT DoesAutoRenewAssetByDefault, Name, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType, Status FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC
SELECT ArePartialPeriodsAllowed, Name, ProrationPolicyType, RemainderStrategy FROM ProrationPolicy
SELECT IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ProrationPolicyId FROM ProductSellingModelOption ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT AssociatedProductRoleCat, MainProductRoleCat, Name FROM ProductRelationshipType ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT CatalogType, Code, Description, EffectiveEndDate, EffectiveStartDate, Name FROM ProductCatalog ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory ORDER BY Code ASC
SELECT IsPrimaryCategory, ProductId, ProductCategoryId FROM ProductCategoryProduct ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT ChildProductId, ChildProductClassificationId, ChildProductRole, ChildSellingModelId, DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild, IsComponentRequired, IsDefaultComponent, IsQuantityEditable, MaxQuantity, MinQuantity, ParentProductId, ParentProductRole, ParentSellingModelId, ProductComponentGroupId, ProductRelationshipTypeId, Quantity, QuantityScaleMethod, QuoteVisibility, Sequence, UnitOfMeasureId FROM ProductRelatedComponent ORDER BY ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC
